items.title: Stocks to Watch: Apple, Amazon, SK Hynix, Roblox
items.summary: ↗️ SK Hynix (KR:000660), Samsung (KR:005930): Shares of both chipmakers surged over 25% in Asian trading, staging a strong recovery after a turbulent week. U.S.-listed peers Marvell (MRVL) and Intel (INTC) also moved higher.

items.title: Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, Micron, Roblox, Reddit, SK Hynix, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: It’s looking like a positive end to a bad month as stocks rose Friday with the tech rebound continuing even as  Apple  decline weighed on the major indexes.  Amazon  gained 15% after second-quarter earnings and revenue comfortably beat expectations.  Alphabet  and  Meta Platforms  were both punished by the market after hiking capex this earnings season.

items.title: Should You Buy, Sell, or Hold ALAB Stock Before Q2 Earnings Release?
items.summary: Astera Labs Q2 earnings are likely to gain from strong AI connectivity momentum, but margin pressure, rich valuation, and rising competition could keep investors cautious.

items.title: Marvell Technology Is Betting More Of Its Revenue On One End Market
items.summary: Three-quarters of its sales already come from data centers, and the company's own guidance widens that share even as it plans for cloud spending growth to cool.

items.title: Broadcom No Longer Sells Itself As A Chip Cycle Story
items.summary: The business management once framed around a cyclical bottom is still growing, but it now gets a paragraph while artificial intelligence gets the company.

items.title: Marvell Down Huge This Month: The Pros See 120% Returns in 12 Months
items.summary: Marvell collapsed 32% in a single month while 44 analysts refused to cut their targets, leaving a widening gap between where the stock trades and where the Street thinks it belongs.

items.title: 24-Year-Old’s $45 Billion Hedge Fund Blows Up Days After Cramer Warned of the Dangers of Margin Trading
items.summary: A 24-year-old wunderkind turned a few hundred million dollars into a $45 billion AI hedge fund in under two years, then watched it all collapse in a single week after a paired trade that seemed bulletproof suddenly moved against him on both sides at once.
